*   **Premiums:** The premiums paid include the insurance agent/marketer commission.
*   **Policy Changes:** You will be notified of any changes to the policy terms at least 30 working days before they take effect, while still adhering to the prevailing policy provisions.
*   **Policy Documentation:** The brochure is not part of the insurance policy or a legal agreement; you are fully bound by the terms detailed in your actual Policy.
*   **Product Details:** Detailed information regarding terms, conditions, specific fee structures, and exclusions can be found in the General and Personal Product and Service Information Summaries (RIPLAY) and your Policy document.
*   **Application Rights:** PT Asuransi Allianz Life Indonesia reserves the right to reject a policy application if it does not meet the applicable requirements and regulations.
